verifiedOutcomes: Three distinct system identities and system/organization/module breadcrumbs, including account detail.
Demo accounts autofill without autosubmit; explicit real login/logout returns to the corresponding system.
All 12 role/viewport shell scenarios passed; no document overflow at declared widths; scoped Axe checks and functional drawer keyboard behavior passed.
Hospital overview shows six complete account rows at 1440x900; last row bottom 883.796875px.
Account search/filter data agree with actual API responses; insurer mutation controls absent and three forbidden read probes return HTTP 403.
Manual landing carousel, keyboard flip controls, inert hidden faces and snap-to-first position verified with real user controls.
WebGL renders on eligible desktop, SVG serves coarse/mobile; pointer settling, offscreen pause, reduced motion and forced-colors fallback checked. Control context loss/restoration checked.
Final Prismatic native scroll/pointer race regression passed three cycles, preference recovery via pointermove, finite idle motion and readable reduced/forced-colors output.
runnerCorrections: Carousel screenshot previously captured intermediate smooth-scroll position; now waits stable snap, first position and disabled previous button. No forced instantaneous screenshot alignment.

Global reveal assertion incorrectly expected any visible pixel to satisfy an 8% IntersectionObserver/rootMargin threshold; contractual showcase elements are now each scrolled into sufficient view before asserting visible.

Additional diagnostic protocol round trips masked the Prismatic event-order race in one diagnostic pass. A separate minimal native reproduction captured the failure; final regression preserves immediate scroll-to-pointer ordering.
limitations: Not every scenario reran on final image. Unchanged scope reuses identified prior-run evidence.
Chrome CDP did not expose document.hidden=true when another owned tab was brought forward. Actual background-tab pause remains unverified; offscreen and idle pause are verified.
Mobile/tablet runs are Chrome emulation on macOS, not physical Android/iOS devices, Safari or Windows.
Axe excludes full aesthetic approval and cannot resolve every gradient/transparency/canvas contrast case; incomplete results remain in raw reports.
No FPS, battery, production load, full security audit, native-platform certification or production release approval is inferred.
No business-data creation/update, commercial-form submission, email delivery or payments were performed; authentication/session audit is the only expected mutation.
